title: Enforce verified-only serving in dispatch after cleanup
goal:
Enforce verified-only serving in dispatch after cleanup
Source: docs/tasks/b3401f19-2897-4049-aa3c-227bcee46a4c/RESPONSE.md WP-G (decision-gated), RESPONSE_SURVEY.md q3/q21. Parent bug: task b3401f19. NOT required to fix the reported bug.

Context (RESPONSE.md WP-G): survey q3 says unverified models should "never be treated as served". WP-C applies that to the CATALOGUE and counts. Applying it to DISPATCH (buildFleetModelCatalog, runnerMatches, confirmRunnerModel unknown => not claimable) would immediately break any runner still relying on pins, so it must wait until WP-F shows every live runner reporting healthy discovery. The human reviewer must decide whether WP-G is wanted at all, or whether dispatch keeps trusting declarations as an operator escape hatch.

Files owned: api/flow/dispatch/fleetModelCatalog.js (buildFleetModelCatalog), api/flow/dispatch/runnerMatches/*, api/flow/dispatch/runnerModelConfirmation.js (dispatch-facing claim verdicts -- WP-C owns only catalogue-facing verdicts; coordinate to avoid collision), and their tests.

Change (only if human approves): unverified (pinned/allowlisted but never discovery-confirmed) models become NOT claimable in dispatch; confirmRunnerModel unknown verdict no longer counts as served for claim eligibility; operator escape hatch retained or explicitly removed per the human decision.

Survey constraints: q21 "adopt after cleanup proves healthy" (NOT switch immediately, NOT never); q3 unverified never treated as served.

Acceptance: with healthy post-WP-F discovery, dispatch claims only discovery-confirmed models; a runner relying solely on pins gets no claims for unconfirmed ids; full dispatch + runnerMatches suites pass; the human dispatch decision is recorded in the task docs. Sequencing: BLOCKED BY WP-F; needs the human go/no-go decision first -- if the decision is "keep trusting declarations", close this ticket as wont-do with the rationale recorded.
